service.name: Celestial Archive Hand Ritual
service.video_goal: Learn the four gestures before enabling the camera

features.title: Open palm browses
features.caption:
Open your palm. Move gently to browse.
张开手掌，轻轻左右移动。

features.title: One finger aims
features.caption:
Point with one finger to aim.
伸出食指，瞄准想选的牌。

features.title: Pinch commits once
features.caption:
Pinch and hold briefly to select.
捏合并短暂停留，选取一张牌。

features.title: Release before next selection
features.caption:
Open your hand. Repeat for three cards.
张开手后再次捏合，共选三张牌。
